title: Aspen Art Museum — Fall Exhibitions
venue: Aspen Art Museum, 637 E Hyman Ave
blurb: Free, always. This fall: Adrián Villar Rojas's monumental 'First Gods, Lost Animals,' Arch Connelly's 'Straighten Your Wig and Pray' (through Oct 11), and Anthea Hamilton's 'Cauliflower Sundial' — plus the rooftop for the view.
price_info: Free
fit_note: A quiet, contemplative morning — and the rooftop view is worth the trip alone.

title: Aspen Filmfest — Opening Day (47th)
venue: The Grove, 315 E Hyman Ave, Aspen (opening reception); screenings at Isis Theatre, 406 E Hopkins Ave
blurb: Six days of international and independent film — features and docs from Cannes, Sundance, Telluride, and Venice — opens at the Isis. Tickets on sale now; the full program is at aspenfilm.org.
price_info: Opening reception: Filmfest passholders & Aspen Film members only (RSVP required); screenings ticketed via aspenfilmfest2026.eventive.org
fit_note: The week's best indoor evening — festival energy without the ski-season crowds.

title: Michigander at Belly Up
venue: Belly Up Aspen, 450 S Galena St
blurb: Jason Singer's Michigander brings earnest, heartland indie-rock to the Belly Up stage, with Jake Lemond opening. Doors 7 PM, show 8 PM. All ages (under 18 with a parent or guardian).
price_info: $45.60 GA / $93.48 Reserved (includes all fees)
age_policy: All Ages. Under 18 must be accompanied by a parent or legal guardian.
fit_note: For the indie-rock fan — intimate room, big choruses.

title: John Denver Celebration — Opening Day
venue: Various venues, Aspen & Snowmass
blurb: The annual tribute week opens — concerts of Denver's songbook at the Wheeler and the Snowmass Chapel, plus nightly sing-alongs of 'Rocky Mountain High' and 'Country Roads.' Each event is run by its own organizer; the full schedule is on the celebration site.
price_info: Varies by event (free nightly sing-a-longs, donation-based concerts, $195 horseback ride)
fit_note: Peak fall color meets the valley's most heartfelt tradition — made for the sing-along crowd.

title: An Evening with Tom Rush accompanied by Brendan Cleary
venue: Wheeler Opera House
blurb: A foundational figure of the '60s folk revival, with his distinctive guitar work and songs by Joni Mitchell, James Taylor, and Jackson Browne in his repertoire. An intimate acoustic evening in the 1889 opera house — the room is half the experience.
fit_note: For the folk traditionalist — a master in the perfect room.

title: An Evening with Pink Talking Fish
venue: Belly Up Aspen, 450 S Galena St
blurb: A high-wire hybrid tribute — Pink Floyd, Talking Heads, and Phish fused into one late-night set. Doors 8 PM, show 9 PM. 21+, valid photo ID required.
price_info: From $33.60 (unverified — official ticket page failed to render)
age_policy: 21+ (unverified by official source this round — official ticket page failed to render; matches prior Concierge Desk venue research)
fit_note: The late-night counterprogramming to the Wheeler's folk evening.

title: Mack Bailey and Chris Nole: Poems, Prayers & Promises: The Songs of John Denver
venue: Wheeler Opera House
blurb: 'Poems, Prayers & Promises' — an intimate concert of John Denver's songbook, part of the week's Celebration. Warmth, honesty, and the songs the whole valley knows by heart.
fit_note: The Celebration's centerpiece concert — book ahead.

title: Aspen Saturday Market — Season Finale
venue: Downtown Aspen (Galena & Hopkins)
blurb: The last market of the 2026 season — fall produce, apple cider, pumpkins, and the final roundup of Colorado artisans. Arrive early; the send-off crowds come out for this one.
price_info: Free
fit_note: Bookend the week where it started — one last stroll before checkout.

title: Carbondale Potato Day
venue: Main Street & Sopris Park, Carbondale
blurb: Carbondale's harvest tradition since 1909 — parade down Main Street, community BBQ, farm market, and kids' activities in Sopris Park, 30 minutes down-valley. The pancake breakfast starts at 8 if you're early.
price_info: Free (food for purchase)
fit_note: Small-town Colorado at its most charming — an easy morning drive before departure.

title: Aspen Filmfest — Closing Weekend
venue: Isis Theatre, 406 E Hopkins Ave, Aspen (screenings); closing reception Sat Oct 3, 10pm, Caribou Club
blurb: The festival heads into its closing weekend — catch the features and docs you missed earlier in the week, before the Sunday encores in Carbondale.
price_info: Ticketed per screening/event; closing reception passholders & members only (RSVP required)
fit_note: A second bite at the week's biggest arts event.

title: Changemaker Speaker Series Kiliii Yuyan: Indigenous Wisdom for a Modern World
venue: Wheeler Opera House
blurb: National Geographic explorer and photographer Kiliii Yuyan brings the Wheeler's Changemaker Speaker Series a talk on indigenous wisdom for the modern world. Thoughtful, image-rich, and unlike anything else on the October calendar.
fit_note: Culture-hungry guests who want a night with substance.

title: Manual Cinema's The 4th Witch
venue: Wheeler Opera House
blurb: Chicago's Manual Cinema stages a shadow-puppetry cinema-theater piece at the Wheeler — handmade film, live music, and overhead projectors. Single-source listing so far; confirm time with the venue before sending guests.
fit_note: Artsy guests and adventurous families.

title: Vienna Boys Choir
venue: Wheeler Opera House
blurb: Five centuries of choral tradition in one of the world's most famous boy choirs, in the jewel-box Wheeler. A rare Aspen appearance and a genuinely special night.
fit_note: Music lovers; an elegant family night out.

title: Metalachi
venue: Belly Up Aspen, 450 S Galena St
blurb: The world's first heavy-metal mariachi band: full mariachi instrumentation playing metal classics. Loud, joyful, and completely unserious — a Belly Up specialty.
price_info: From $45 (unverified — official ticket page failed to render)
fit_note: Groups that want a fun, unpretentious night out.

title: Digable Planets
venue: Belly Up Aspen, 450 S Galena St
blurb: The Grammy-winning jazz-rap trio behind 'Rebirth of Slick (Cool Like Dat)' brings their smooth, crate-digger cool to the 450-cap Belly Up room. An intimate room for a legendary act.
price_info: From $116 (unverified)
fit_note: Hip-hop and jazz fans; a standout date night.

title: Haunted Hotel Halloween Party at W Aspen
venue: W Aspen, 550 S Spring Street, Aspen, CO 81611
blurb: Step inside W Aspen's darker side for a night of spooky cocktails, immersive DJ sets, and a costume contest that transforms the hotel.
price_info: Tickets via Eventbrite
fit_note: Halloween night itself — DJ sets, spooky cocktails, and a costume contest. Book ahead; refunds up to 7 days before the event.

title: The Black Angels with GHOSTWOMAN
venue: Belly Up Aspen, 450 S Galena St
blurb: Austin's psych-rock torchbearers bring their drone-heavy, Velvet Underground-descended sound to Belly Up, with GHOSTWOMAN opening. Expect it loud.
price_info: From $105 (unverified)
fit_note: Rock fans; late-night energy seekers.

title: Foy Vance World Tour with Bonnie Bishop & Ryan McMullan
venue: Wheeler Opera House
blurb: Northern Irish singer-songwriter Foy Vance — a favorite of Ed Sheeran and Elton John — brings his soulful, gravel-voiced songs to the Wheeler. A songwriter's songwriter in a listening room built for exactly this.
fit_note: Music lovers who listen closely.

title: Bonobo
venue: Belly Up Aspen, 450 S Galena St
blurb: Simon Green's downtempo electronic project lands at Belly Up — lush, cinematic, and built for a dark room with a good system. A coup booking for a 450-cap room.
price_info: From $126 (unverified)
fit_note: Electronic music fans; a sophisticated night out.

title: Suzy Bogguss: A Swingin' Little Christmas
venue: Wheeler Opera House
blurb: Country veteran Suzy Bogguss swings through holiday classics with western-swing charm at the Wheeler. The Saturday after Thanksgiving — an easy, joyful family night.
fit_note: Families in town for Thanksgiving week.

title: The Wooten Brothers
venue: Wheeler Opera House
blurb: Victor Wooten — five-time Grammy winner and arguably the most influential living bassist — with his brothers. A masterclass disguised as a concert.
fit_note: Musicians and serious music fans.

title: EDDiE iFFT: The Last Chair Tour
venue: Wheeler Opera House
blurb: Veteran stand-up Eddie Ifft's early show on a double-comedy Saturday at the Wheeler. Sharp, road-tested, and an easy ticket.
fit_note: Adults wanting a laugh before dinner.

title: Ismo: Perseverance Tour
venue: Wheeler Opera House
blurb: Finnish comedian Ismo mines the absurdity of the English language — a clean, clever hour that plays beautifully to smart crowds. Late show of the Wheeler's comedy double-header.
fit_note: Wordplay lovers; a bright night out.

title: DanceAspen: A Snowy Soiree
venue: Wheeler Opera House
blurb: Aspen's own contemporary dance company takes the Wheeler stage for a winter soiree two days before Christmas. Local, beautiful, and brief.
fit_note: Dance and arts patrons; holiday-week guests.

title: John Oates and the Good Road Band
venue: Wheeler Opera House
blurb: Half of Hall & Oates brings his roots-and-Americana band to the Wheeler between Christmas and New Year's. Expect the hits reimagined and deep cuts.
fit_note: Holiday-week guests; classic rock fans.

title: LCD Soundsystem — New Year's Eve 2026
venue: Belly Up Aspen, 450 S Galena St
blurb: James Murphy's dance-punk institution headlines Belly Up's New Year's run — three nights in a 450-cap room. These will not last.
price_info: Not on sale — Join Waitlist on bellyupaspen.com
fit_note: The booking of the season; act fast.

title: LCD Soundsystem — New Year's Eve 2026
venue: Belly Up Aspen, 450 S Galena St
blurb: Ring in 2027 with LCD Soundsystem at Belly Up — the room's biggest New Year's Eve in years. Book the moment tickets move.
price_info: Not on sale — Join Waitlist on bellyupaspen.com
fit_note: The NYE splurge.

title: Chris Collins & Boulder Canyon — John Denver Tribute
venue: Wheeler Opera House, 320 E Hyman Ave
blurb: Night two at the Wheeler for the Celebration — Chris Collins and Boulder Canyon play the Denver songbook front to back. The valley sings along; it always does.
price_info: Ticketed (aspenshowtix.com)
fit_note: The Celebration's closing-night sing-along — book ahead.

title: Snowmass Balloon Festival — Final Launch
venue: Snowmass Town Park, 2000 Brush Creek Rd, Snowmass Village
blurb: The last morning of the festival's 51st year — the final mass ascension over Snowmass Town Park. Same drill: layers, blankets, arrive early; balloons go up weather permitting.
price_info: Free
fit_note: Your second chance if Saturday's weather didn't cooperate.

title: Aspen Literary Festival — Closing Day
venue: Downtown Aspen (Wheeler Opera House, Library, Community Church)
blurb: The festival's second year closes with a full day of author conversations, panels, and signings across downtown — Jennette McCurdy, Richard Russo, Veronica Roth, and more on the lineup. Most events are free with registration; marquee Wheeler main-stage sessions are ticketed.
price_info: Free GA (registration required); Wheeler main stage events $45
fit_note: For readers — the cultural high point of the weekend, and mostly free.

title: Aspen Restaurant Week Autumn — Final Evening
venue: Participating restaurants, Aspen
blurb: The last evening of the autumn edition — prix fixe, multi-course fall-harvest menus at 25+ local restaurants, from Matsuhisa to Wild Fig. Reserve ahead; menus and the full restaurant list are at the Chamber.
price_info: Prix fixe (specially priced multi-course menus; varies by restaurant)
fit_note: The week's best-value fine dining — book the table tonight, it ends Sunday.

title: Bombargo at Belly Up
venue: Belly Up Aspen, 450 S Galena St
blurb: Saskatoon-bred Bombargo bring their big-chorus pop-rock to the Belly Up room, with Graham Good & The Painters opening. Doors 7 PM, show 8 PM. All ages (under 18 with a parent or guardian).
price_info: $12.00 GA / $48.00 Reserved / $104.55 VIP package (includes all fees)
age_policy: All Ages. Under 18 must be accompanied by a parent or legal guardian.
fit_note: A high-energy night out for the group that wants to dance.

title: Maroon Bells at Peak Color
venue: Maroon Bells Scenic Area (shuttle from Aspen Highlands)
blurb: Late September is the peak window for the gold — the most photographed peaks in North America at their most golden. Between 8am and 5pm all visitors must use the shuttle from Aspen Highlands; reserve ahead, it sells out in color season.
price_info: Shuttle $16/adult; $10 children (12 & under) and seniors (65+); parking $10/vehicle; reservations required
fit_note: The can't-miss of the week for anyone who hasn't seen the Bells in fall.
